name: M.A Break MT5
summary: This EA implements a Moving Average breakout strategy for MT5, entering trades when price breaks through a defined moving average level. Separate versions exist for buy and sell directions, each targeting breakouts in their respective direction. The strategy uses moving average crossovers or price-to-MA breakouts as primary signals with configurable parameters for MA period and method.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于均线突破的策略，当价格突破设定的移动平均线时进场交易。分为买入和卖出两个独立版本，分别针对各自方向的突破进行交易。策略以均线突破作为主要信号，支持配置均线周期和方法等参数。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是均线突破，即当价格突破移动平均线时产生交易信号。入场条件为价格向上突破均线时开多单，价格向下突破均线时开空单。出场条件可能依赖固定止盈止损或反向突破信号。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式。资金管理较为基础，缺乏动态调整机制如根据波动率调整仓位。策略分为独立的买入和卖出版本，这种设计虽然简化了逻辑但不利于统一风控管理。整体而言，该策略逻辑清晰但缺乏复杂的风险控制和过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is a moving average breakout, generating trade signals when price breaks through a defined moving average level. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the MA and a sell when price breaks below the MA. Exit conditions likely rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or opposite breakout signals. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a balance-based lot calculation method. Money management is basic, lacking dynamic adjustment mechanisms such as volatility-based position sizing. The strategy is split into separate buy and sell EA versions, which simplifies individual logic but hinders unified risk management. Overall, the strategy logic is clear but lacks sophisticated risk controls and filtering mechanisms.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
均线突破是经典有效的技术分析方法
分为独立买卖版本降低了单版本复杂度
参数可配置性强，便于优化和回测
入场信号明确，不模棱两可
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
Moving average breakout is a proven and effective technical analysis method
Separating buy/sell versions reduces individual EA complexity
Highly configurable parameters facilitate optimization and backtesting
Entry signals are explicit and unambiguous
cons: 缺乏多重过滤机制容易产生虚假信号
独立买卖版本不利于统一风险管理和资金控制
没有趋势强度过滤可能在震荡市中频繁亏损
仓位管理较为基础缺乏动态调整
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks multi-layer filtering, prone to false signals in choppy markets
Separate buy/sell versions hinder unified risk and capital management
No trend strength filter may cause frequent losses in ranging markets
Position sizing is basic without dynamic adjustment
Missing new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same signal
improvements: 合并买卖版本为单一EA并加入方向控制参数，便于统一管理
增加ATR波动率过滤和多重确认机制减少虚假突破
improvements_en: Merge buy and sell versions into a single EA with direction control parameter for unified management
Add ATR volatility filter and multi-confirmation mechanism to reduce false breakouts

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查可能导致重复开仓增加风险
震荡行情中均线突破容易产生虚假信号造成连续亏损
独立买卖版本难以协调总仓位可能导致过度敞口
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause duplicate entries increasing risk
MA breakouts in ranging markets easily produce false signals leading to consecutive losses
Separate buy/sell versions make total position coordination difficult, potentially causing overexposure
